semiconductor_relevance: High — The company holds a 95% market share in global IC substrate lamination systems, a critical process in semiconductor packaging.
summary: Eternal Precision Mechanics Co., Ltd. specializes in high-yield vacuum lamination equipment for the semiconductor industry, particularly in IC substrate packaging. With proprietary film handling technology and high-precision thermal press systems, they ensure superior flatness and precision in substrate lamination.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Eternal Precision Mechanics Co., Ltd. is part of the Eternal Materials Group, a leading Taiwanese materials supplier.
regional_presence.Japan: Supported by its Japanese subsidiary, Nikko-Materials Co., Ltd., which has over 20 years of experience in vacuum lamination equipment.
